build_RoITrackHead: build a RoITrackHead module with roi_extractor and embed_head config dicts for multi-object tracking
init_embed_head_RoITrackHead: initialize the embed_head and roi_extractor submodules from config dicts in RoITrackHead
extract_roi_feats_RoITrackHead: extract ROI features from multi-level image features and bounding boxes using RoITrackHead
loss_RoITrackHead: calculate tracking losses from key and reference frame features with RPN proposals and data samples
predict_RoITrackHead: predict similarity logits between current and previous ROI features for tracking association
